blind.description: A stylized low pile consisting of three to four chunky, faceted dark-brown stone blocks or pavers resting within a bed of smaller sandy-tan pebbles, dirt, and gravel. The rocks feature hand-painted style edge highlights and weathered surfaces. The mesh is solid, continuous, and grounded with no floating, melted, or detached elements.
blind.from_above: A roughly triangular or rounded cluster of several dark angular rock slabs framed by a fringe of smaller tan pebbles and gravel.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 foot tall (reaching roughly ankle to shin height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 to 2.5 feet wide across.
